description: This file defines the 'ResourceOptimizedPlacementDirector' class, which implements placement logic for silos in Orleans, with resource-aware algorithms for placement decisions based on silo statistics and constraints.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementDirector
classes.description: A class implementing a resource-optimized placement strategy for silos in Orleans, considering resource usage and capacity for dynamic placement decisions.

methods.name: NormalizeWeights
methods.description: Normalizes the various weights provided in configuration to a proportional scale used in scoring silos.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the most suitable silo for activation placement based on resource scores and constraints.

methods.name: RemoveSilo
methods.description: Removes the silo's statistics from the internal tracking.

methods.name: SiloStatisticsChangeNotification
methods.description: Updates internal silo statistics based on runtime statistics changes.
